meaning:
αἱρέω,
[in LXX for אמר hi., בּחר, etc. ;]
to take; Mid., -ομαι (M, Pr., 158 f.; MM, VGT, see word), to choose: Php.1:22, 2Th.2:13, Heb.11:25. (Cf. ἀν-, ἀφ-, δι-, ἐξ-, καθ-, περι-, προ-αιρέω.) †
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through…
choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,
